At that time, his brilliance was unparalleled; he claimed mastery over all mechanisms and saw no need to borrow prestige from past sages, insisting on using his own name as Grand Artisan, which drew much criticism.
Later, when Crow received his title, Zhang Wanshi was already waiting outside the hall.
"It just occurred to me—since you’re receiving your title today, our master ought to give a gift. But our master is rarely home, so I’ll stand in. Here, newly forged." A sharp sword, sheathed in an antique scabbard. "The Sword of Triumph."

Zhang Wanshi knew his junior brother would return victorious.
And Crow understood that his senior brother never imposed his own ambitions on others.
